hub.name: Scotland
hub.title: Headstone Restoration, Inscriptions & New Memorials | M. Wallace Memorials
hub.description: Memorial cleaning and restoration, additional inscriptions, lead lettering and new bespoke memorials across the central belt of Scotland and the islands. Bases in Cumbernauld and Kinross. Free quotes.
hub.lede: Memorial cleaning and restoration, additional inscriptions, traditional lead lettering and new bespoke memorials, carried out in cemeteries and churchyards across the central belt of Scotland and the islands.
hub.local: We have two bases, Cumbernauld for the west and Kinross for the east, so the team nearest to you looks after your enquiry. Between them we cover a wide range of the central belt of Scotland and the islands. Not sure which side you're on? Just tell us which cemetery the stone is in and we'll pass it to the right team.

regions.name: West Scotland
regions.title: Headstone Restoration & Inscriptions in West Scotland | M. Wallace Memorials
regions.description: Headstone cleaning and restoration, additional inscriptions, lead lettering and new bespoke memorials across Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Stirling, Falkirk, Ayrshire and the islands. Based in Cumbernauld. Free quotes.
regions.local: Our west team is based in Cumbernauld, right in the middle of the central belt, so Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Falkirk and Stirling are all close by. We also cover Ayrshire, Dunbartonshire, Renfrewshire and the islands, and we're happy to take the ferry: we've taken the van over to Rothesay on Bute for jobs.

regions.name: East Scotland
regions.title: Headstone Restoration & Inscriptions in East Scotland | M. Wallace Memorials
regions.description: Headstone cleaning and restoration, additional inscriptions, lead lettering and new bespoke memorials across Perth & Kinross, Fife, Edinburgh, the Lothians and Dundee. Based in Kinross. Free quotes.
regions.local: Our east team is based in Kinross, so Perth & Kinross, Fife, Clackmannanshire, Edinburgh and the Lothians, and Dundee and Angus are all within easy reach. Recent jobs have taken us to a churchyard in Fife, a family stone in Edinburgh and up to Blair Atholl churchyard in Highland Perthshire.
